item.title: Student-led petition forces ICE to back out of ASU Law School career event
item.description: The U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement withdrew from participating in an Arizona State University Law School event set for Thursday following a student-led petition. ICE had planned to host a table at the Government and Public Interest Table Talks event until 650 people signed a petition to protest the federal law enforcement agency’s participation, according […]

item.title: Christendom College cancels classes so students can attend March for Life
item.description: Christendom College helped encourage students to attend the March for Life - and almost all did.

item.title: Liberals love new ‘Starfleet Academy’ series; modern progressive dogma explains why
item.description: Dave Huber critiques the new "Starfleet Academy" series, arguing it’s poorly written and overly focused on identity politics, neglecting Star Trek’s established lore. He suggests the show reflects contemporary progressive ideology, which he believes is detrimental. Huber contrasts the idealized Federation with modern critiques of America, asserting both face unwarranted skepticism in today’s climate.

item.title: U. Arkansas students protest revocation of job offer to pro-transgender law school dean
item.description: University of Arkansas students protested the revocation of law school dean Emily Suski's job offer due to her pro-transgender advocacy. Critics, including Republican lawmakers, prompted the decision, which sparked outrage among students and faculty. Attendees expressed their commitment to free speech and the importance of academic independence in higher education.

item.title: Indiana U. professor sanctioned for creating ‘hostile environment’ for white students
